description:
Solve a Cloudflare Turnstile widget or a Cloudflare WAF interstitial. Discriminates the embedded widget (.cf-turnstile/[data-sitekey], challenge iframe, #challenge-stage) from an interstitial (#challenge-form, /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/, no widget); widget mode presses the checkbox inside the widget frame's shadow root after a short silent managed-pass wait, interstitial mode waits for the challenge iframe and reloads the challenge traffic within a wall-clock cap. Writes the token into cf-turnstile-response (or data-response-field-name) before invoking the page callback, never double-invokes a callback that already fired, maps 110200/600010/timeout-or-duplicate/chl-missing/internal and 300x/600x to abort, retry or reload, caps retries at 5 and the call at 90s by default. Manual, deterministic gate: embed
with https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js and call until the gate opens (1x00000000000000000000AA always passes; 3x00000000000000000000FF forces the click path).

frame.description: Frame holding the Turnstile widget, from playwright_frames. Default: auto-resolve the challenge iframe from the host element, frame URL, or documented iframe classes.

maxAttempts.description: Press/reset rounds before giving up (default and cap: 5). A token timeout, an interaction timeout, a challenge failure or an internal error retries; a domain mismatch aborts immediately.

maxMs.description: Wall-clock cap for the whole call (default 90000).

revealToken.description: Return the full token instead of a redacted head/tail. The page keeps the full value either way.

sitekey.description: Expected data-sitekey, checked when one is present so a wrong widget is reported instead of pressed. The documented test keys are 1x00000000000000000000AA (always passes, visible), 2x00000000000000000000AB (always passes, invisible), 2x00000000000000000000BB (always fails, visible) and 3x00000000000000000000FF (forces interaction).

submit.description: CSS selector of the host submit control, clicked after a token is captured. Off by default so the caller keeps control of submission.

tokenTtlMs.description: How long a press may take to produce a non-empty cf-turnstile-response token (default 15000). Expiry is a retry, not a pass.

name: playwright_captcha_turnstile
